structured_output.world_model:
W3 (cost lens), after E055. The tip is E049 (237 steps, 5.20 s). I put its population mean at about 0.7535, so it has almost no margin for the PCIe judge.

Time model: time ≈ 0.25 s plus the sum over steps of the per-step cost. Per-step cost by resolution is 32 px 0.032 s, 28 px 0.026 s, 24 px 0.021 s and 20 px 0.016 s. The stem freeze saves about 8.7 ms per 32 px step, and the group-2 freeze saves about 10 ms more. Whitening detach at 20 px saves only about 1 ms per step.

Exchange rates (seconds saved per pp lost): the epoch dial is 1–2.5. The free truncations are used up: E055 (stem freeze at 71%) read −0.16 pp for −0.07 s, worse than the dial.

Code facts:
- The BN scale is already frozen: `BatchNorm.__init__` sets `weight.requires_grad=False`. So I092 closes on reading the code.
- Muon renormalizes the filters every step. So filter wd has no effect, and the filters' relative update rate ≈ lr × const. That means the ΔW/W curves (I094) will mostly just replay the LR schedules and cannot separate E028 from E037.

Noise: the 3-seed mean moves about ±0.25 pp across rebuilds, and per-seed SD is about 0.3 pp. A 20-seed same-build comparison resolves about 0.1 pp; across builds it resolves only 0.15 pp or worse.

Strategy: re-price existing commits (E052/E046) under an honest gate; take tiny truncations (whitening at 6%); otherwise buy margin with steps. Boosters stay at a prior of −0.05 ± 0.2 pp.

forecasts.reason: Past same-commit rebuilds moved the 3-seed mean by up to 0.35 pp, so kernel reselection should leave a correlated shift of ≥0.08 pp across three builds.
E052/E053 sit about 0.2 pp below E049, near 0.7518. With σ_tot ≈ 0.14 pp the gate needs ≥ 0.7523, so P ≥ 0.9 likely fails for at least one of them.
Δtime is about 0.12 s, but Δacc of about 0.1 pp is below the cross-build resolution once σ_build is added, so the dial estimate stays wide.
The harness supplies fine labels only, so the coarse mapping would be external and the idea is likely blocked. If it does run, my booster prior is about −0.05 pp.
The port already sets BN weight requires_grad=False, so this closes on reading the code with no effect.
About 33 cheaper 20 px steps at about 1 ms each saves roughly 0.04 s (0.7%). The bias is near-converged by 6%, as in airbench96 and Hiverge, so the accuracy loss should be ≤0.05 pp.
With Muon renormalizing the filters, ΔW/W tracks the per-group LR schedules, so the curves will not separate E028 from E037/E055 on learning progress.

cruxes: What is σ_build for a 20-seed mean (I088)? If it is ≥0.1 pp, every sub-0.15 pp keep or discard since E044 is noise. The gate then has to price E052/E053 as indistinguishable from E049, and their 0.2 s savings might be taken by buying back margin with steps.
Is E049's population mean on fresh seeds 33–52 at or above 0.7535, or about 0.752 (winner's curse)? If it is lower, the next move is adding steps, not cutting them.
Do training-BN reductions on the 31×31/15×15 maps run below the bandwidth floor (H6.5.3)? That is the only identical-math lever left that could be larger than 1%.
